gates.asks: The Initiate's robe is indigo with a lit side: not navy, not near-black, under about 45% dark pixels; its eyes and candle read at zoom 0.75.

measured.rule: dark share (L* under 35, outline excluded) under 45%; mean cloth hue 236 to 256; at least a quarter of the cloth lit (value 0.55 and more); lit cloth at least 40 from the Undead near-black #313135

gates.byEye: On sample-zoom-0.75.png the two cream eyes are the first thing read on every ground, and the candle is a cream stub with a green flame beside the body; the flame is 8 px at that zoom and weakest on Grass and Snow. The robe reads indigo, lighter on the left; its shading is shallow (the accent compresses it).

gates.asks: The Horror has no cloth and no hood although layer 3 names cloth.

measured.rule: by eye: the blue of the sprite (hue 228 to 266) is the shade of the teal body, which no measure tells from cloth

gates.byEye: No robe, hood, cloak or other cloth on sample-x4.png: a bare teal ball with a brass collar. The measured blue is the navy shade of the teal body, not cloth.

gates.asks: The Herald fills the canvas height (100 px or more) and is not shorter than any giant of the review's lineup; its eye reads at zoom 0.75.

measured.rule: opaque height at least 100 px and at least the tallest giant's

gates.byEye: On giants-x2.png the Herald stands level with the Brass Titan and under the Gingerbread Giant only; the yellow eye is the brightest shape of the sprite at zoom 0.75.

gates.asks: Green is small on all three and lands on hue 148 after the accent step; no pixel is red, violet or magenta.

measured.rule: green (the accent band: hue 80 to 152, saturation 0.5 and more) at most 8% of each sprite and every green tone at hue 144 to 152; no red (hue 345 to 12) and no violet or magenta (hue 270 to 345) pixel

gates.byEye: The only green on the Initiate is the flame. The Horror keeps a few green specks on its head, and the lit tips of the Herald's tentacle crown fall in the accent band and turn green (4% of the sprite): they read as part of the teal crown.

gates.asks: A lineup at native and half size, in colour and greyscale, by the measure of the Dwarf lineup.

measured.rule: every named pair distinct by the Dwarf lineup's calibrated thresholds (lineup.json)

gates.byEye: On lineup-1x.png, at half size and in greyscale: the Initiate is a hood with two white eyes and no staff (Necromancer: beard and skull staff; Ice Witch: pale face and crown); the Horror is a ball with a pale belly band (Spider: flat with eight legs; Bunny: ears); the Herald is a bell with one eye (Lich: raised arms and ribs).
